0022600172.text: The Heat come in at 1-4, sitting 5th in the Southeast and 1.5 games back in the East, where they are 12th. They are 0-3 at home and 1-1 on the road, and they have won their most recent game. The Lakers have started 4-1, lead the Pacific, rank 3rd in the West, and are also on a one-game winning streak. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Miami lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 134-126 defeat in Miami on March 19, 2026.
